purpose: Define AgentSwitchboard's consumer contract for Triage prompt-parallel-dispatch manifests and panel/lane-prompt transport artifacts. This closes the AUTONOMY_GAP by making ASB a machine executor of Triage-generated lanes.
consumer_requirements: Ingest Triage-shaped prompt-parallel-dispatch manifests as first-class machine inputs
Ingest panel/lane-prompt transport artifacts as first-class machine inputs
Classify AUTONOMY_GAP when panels/manifests exist but no adapter would execute lanes
Map ready lanes to ASB descriptors: public-plan, cursor-cloud-agent, local argv
Apply merge-gate classification: degraded provider limits + local_proof => CONTINUE
Accept continue-map checkpoint and extract first_unproven_gate structurally
Never delete or forbid panels as design goal
Treat human paste as portability fallback only, never primary happy path

public_plan.description: Map lane to existing ASB public plan

cursor_cloud_agent.description: Launch Cursor Cloud Agent for lane

local_argv.description: Execute local command for deterministic lanes

proof_ceiling: Contract proof (schemas validate, fixtures pass, policy enforces human_scheduler_allowed:false and panel_ingest_required:true). Static test proof (ingest/classify/map code parses manifests/panels, classifies AUTONOMY_GAP, maps lanes to ASB descriptors structurally, applies merge-gate rules). Does NOT prove live lane dispatch, runtime execution, or Cursor Cloud Agent launch.
